scenes.summary: The investigation has been ongoing for a while but it has found no leads. Both you and Zuo Guyan are left feeling stumped. Chen Qianyu, who has just completed Xiranite Chubby Lung recovery, shares all sorts of reasons for drone malfunctions. One of them catches your attention.

lines.text: Endmin, you're here.
How fares your investigation?
We looked through every place we could think of. A few of us are checking on the damaged Xiranite Chubby Lungs. Operator Chen actually headed out to recover a few.
But...
Yeah ... I'm afraid we didn't find any leads linked to the anomalous data.
According to "The Mysterious Talos-II" chapter three, secrets are often hidden in unassuming corners.
But we've scoured every nook and cranny of Wuling.
Ugh...
Nothing. Maybe the leads are like fowlbeasts. They got wings.
I should think positively. Although we found no leads, the Xiranite Chubby Lungs helped us deal with several Blight concentrations on time and saved quite a few lives.
I also wonder where the problem is.
Heyah, Endmin... Oh, so ... I guess we haven't made any progress on the investigation.
Endmin, wanna know how these Chubby Lungs broke down? The one I just recovered broke when some burdenbeast headbutted it into mid-air!
Headbutted it?
But I recovered from that. Just a few days ago, another Chubby Lung leaped off the mountain and ... smashed itself to pieces.
And then there's another Chubby Lung that ... also tried headbutting an Aggelos and broke its detection module in the process...
The detection module broke in the process?
Maybe the Xiranite seeped into the detection module chip and caused a short circuit. But the module itself looks fine to me.
Do not worry, Endministrator. I have relayed these issues to Tianshi Yan Ning. She and Miss Bai Shuang are tackling these emergency issues as we speak.
But this is my first time hearing a Chubby Lung getting rammed by a burdo.
Yeah. Recovering these Chubby Lungs from the burdo herd wasn't easy, you know. They're strong and stubborn as always.
Some burdo headbutted me really hard and gave me PTSD when I was a kid. Loud noises spooked me and made me think that a burdenbeast was charging at me...
Yeah. Chubby Lungs are so cute. Why would the burdos headbutt them so hard...?
Thankfully these Chubby Lungs are just recon drones. If they were alive, the sound of running burdenbeasts would probably terrify them as well.
The sound of rushing burdenbeasts... Will that invoke a sense of fear?
Recovery has been a success. Let that sink in and stop looking so defeated already. I actually got something interesting to tell you.
Operator Chen! You're back already! How goes the recovery operation?
